name: anylinux-metadata
description: Production-grade community metadata database for Anylinux AppImages not on Flathub

scripts.validate: which bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun run scripts/validate.ts || node --import tsx scripts/validate.ts
scripts.sync: which bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun run scripts/sync-upstream.ts || node --import tsx scripts/sync-upstream.ts
scripts.import: which bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun run scripts/import-pla.ts || node --import tsx scripts/import-pla.ts
scripts.generate-schema: which bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun run scripts/generate-schema.ts || node --import tsx scripts/generate-schema.ts
scripts.export: which bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun run scripts/export-catalog.ts || node --import tsx scripts/export-catalog.ts
scripts.test: which bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun test || node --import tsx --test 'tests/**/*.test.ts'
scripts.enrich: which bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun run scripts/enrich-metadata.ts || node --import tsx scripts/enrich-metadata.ts
scripts.dev: which bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun run scripts/serve.ts || node --import tsx scripts/serve.ts
scripts.serve: which bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun run scripts/serve.ts || node --import tsx scripts/serve.ts

author: AnyLinux Community
